data.name: Durraa
data.gender_notes: Durraa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Durraa is an Arabic name for girls that means 'pearls of corals'. It is derived from the D-R-A root which is used in the Quran. The name Durraa carries the meaning “Pearls of Corals” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Durraa usually hope their child will grow to embody pearls of corals and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes the spiritual wealth and beauty within an individual.
data.etymology: Durraa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pearls of Corals.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Durraa total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_urdu.name: درّاء
in_urdu.long_meaning: درّاء ایک عربی لفظ ہے جس کا مطلب ہے قیمتی موتی، اور یہ نام برصغیر پاک و ہند میں مسلمانوں کے درمیان بہت مقبول ہے، کیونکہ یہ نام روحانی اور مذہبی اہمیت کا حامل ہے

in_hindi.name: दुर्रा

data.cultural_impact: The name Durraa carries a sense of uniqueness, beauty, and richness, as pearls are highly valued in Islamic culture due to their rarity and elegant appearance. They symbolize purity, elegance, and classical beauty. The name is a reminder of the beauty and value of creation in Islamic belief.
data.spiritual_significance: The spiritual significance of the name Durraa can be found in the Quranic usage of the D-R-A root, which represents a precious and safe place or a means of support. In this context, Durraa can be seen as a reminder of the protection and support that Allah provides to His believers. It can also symbolize the pearls of wisdom and knowledge that Allah grants to those who seek Him and strive to be closer to Him. Overall, the name Durraa brings a sense of connection to the rich Islamic cultural heritage and to the divine protection and support of Allah.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Durraa: The radiant and shining beacon, guiding Muslims through the labyrinth of life, towards the shores of eternal bliss.
